# HST Medical

> HST Medical Pte Ltd (Singapore, est. 1994; a Kowa subsidiary since 2024) formulates and supplies health supplements and pain-relief remedies under the HST Medical®, Heritage®, Rheuma-Salve® and Zoo-Vite® brands. Products are GMP-manufactured, many Halal-certified, sold at Guardian, Watsons and NHGP pharmacies and shipped from this store in SGD.

## Ranges
- [Premium Pain Relief](https://technextmarketing.github.io/hst-medical-website/shop/pain-relief/): Rheuma-Salve® balms, creams, liniments and patches for joint pain, muscle aches, sprains and strains.
- [Cough, Cold & Flu](https://technextmarketing.github.io/hst-medical-website/shop/cough-cold-flu/): Herbal lozenges, syrups, remedies and inhalers for cough, sore throat, flu and blocked noses.
- [Traditional Pain Relief](https://technextmarketing.github.io/hst-medical-website/shop/traditional-pain-relief/): Time-tested Heritage® medicated oils for rheumatic pain, bruises and muscle strain.
- [Bones & Joints](https://technextmarketing.github.io/hst-medical-website/shop/bones-joints/): Joint, cartilage, calcium and vitamin D3+K2 support.
- [Immunity & Allergy](https://technextmarketing.github.io/hst-medical-website/shop/immunity-allergy/): Vitamin C, multivitamins and probiotics for daily defence.
- [Immunity & Energy](https://technextmarketing.github.io/hst-medical-website/shop/immunity-energy/): Heritage® ginseng, cordyceps, deer antler and lingzhi tonics in vegicaps.
- [Beauty & Wellness](https://technextmarketing.github.io/hst-medical-website/shop/beauty-wellness/): Squalene, pearl powder, crocodile oil, NMN and hair support from Heritage® and HST Medical®.
- [Kids Supplements](https://technextmarketing.github.io/hst-medical-website/shop/kids/): Zoo-Vite® gummies and jelly sticks for immunity, eyes, brain and daily vitamins.
- [Alertness, Memory & Vision](https://technextmarketing.github.io/hst-medical-website/shop/alertness-memory-vision/): Omega-3, DHA, eye health and ginkgo formulas.
- [Stress, Anxiety & Sleep](https://technextmarketing.github.io/hst-medical-website/shop/stress-sleep/): Magnesium glycinate and pharmaceutical-grade melatonin.
- [Heart, Liver, Urinary & Vitality](https://technextmarketing.github.io/hst-medical-website/shop/heart-liver-vitality/): Men's vitality, liver, urinary and women's health formulas.
